a.lede: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.
a.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access

b.lede: Anthropic's proposal requires evaluators to report any imminent risk to the Department of Commerce within 72 hours, after which the Department must present the evidence to a federal judge and await an order.
b.title: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line
